_comment: Voice registry for the Celebrity Peptide Gone Wrong lane. Engine: Higgsfield Seed Audio 1.0 (seed_audio) via MCP. Cloned voices are 'element' type; pass voice_type+voice_id to generate_audio. See cloning_procedure below to add a new voice.

source.note: Re-cloned on the current Higgsfield account from the same Take 2 reference. The audio_media_id below belongs to the previous account and cannot be reused.

verified_against.method: median F0 + long-term average spectrum vs the approved kandi-burruss front_vo
verified_against.verdict: same speaker; settings carried over unchanged

character3_take2_original_account.reason: lived on the previous Higgsfield account; after the account switch seed_audio returns 400 'Voice not found'. Kept for provenance only.

delivery_style.goal: candid first-person female creator, blunt, a little fast and rhythmic; natural pauses, rushing in spots.
delivery_style.speed: set via speech_rate (locked at 18). Rhythm/pauses come from PUNCTUATION, not the rate param.

markup_rules.breath_pause: ellipsis (…) — use sparingly, NOT stacked at the very start (avoid front-loaded 'pregnant pauses')
markup_rules.banned: do not open with stacked ellipses or repeated openers

delivery_style.reference_line: Okay, this one's bad. You've seen her everywhere lately, right? Everywhere. But nobody's saying what it actually cost her. So look at this. Before, she was fine. Totally fine. And then the shot changed everything.

steps: 1. Get the reference audio (60-120s, clean, single speaker, natural delivery). If it's a video/.mov, extract audio: ffmpeg -i in.mov -vn -ac 1 -ar 44100 -c:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 out.mp3
2. media_upload(filename, content_type audio/mpeg) -> PUT the bytes to the returned signed upload_url (Content-Type: audio/mpeg).
4. create_voice_from_confirmed_audio(audio_media_id, name) -> returns voice_id (element). Wait for status 'completed' & is_audio_eligible true.
5. Test with generate_audio(model seed_audio, voice_type 'element', voice_id, speech_rate, pitch_rate). Do a speech_rate 0 fidelity check first, then dial speed/bass.
6. Record the winner's voice_id + settings in this manifest (voices{}) and set active_voice.

_account_note: Cloned voices are per-account. If seed_audio returns 400 'Voice not found', the account changed - re-run cloning_procedure and update voices.character3.voice_id.
